Description:
You step inside the magic circle, and an incantation of fire, frost, and lightning begins. The figure with robes and glowing eyes moves around, raw energy emanating from their palms. A book lays open on the floor, pages flipping themselves and shifting through bright violet runes. The circle is abruptly broken, and the magic stops, as you notice the Sorcerer caressing his beard, eyes all on you. Did the spell fail? Could this be a mistake? An error in the code of arcane? Sorcerers work in mysterious ways...
Sorcerers are channelers magic, refiners of the coarse arcane, directly from the source, who can transform those vibrations into elemental energies. Mastery over magics has made their spells fast and efficient, but in their choice of spells and invocations, no two Sorcerers are alike.
Wizards are in a continuous study of magic, and their mind is trained for accessing higher-order spells ahead of time, while sorcerers prefer a more random (albeit practical) usage of magic, going with the flow. Artificers are the complete opposite, however, prefering rigurious crafts of trial and error until they excel in their preferred creation field - alchemy, tinkering, even blacksmithing.

Weapons: You are Trained in a Weapon Category of choice (e.g. 1-Handed Melee, 2-Handed Ranged, etc).

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Sorcerer-specific Abilities are considered Spells (except Magic Mastery).

~Unstable Spark~.Effect:
At the start of your every Turn in a Worthy Combat, roll 1d10.
If you roll 1, you take 1d6 True DaSorcerer.
If you roll 10, your next Spell this Turn has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die tier.

~Element Burst~.Effect:
DaSorcerer a Unit for 2d6 {Element} DaSorcerer.
Deals +1d10 DaSorcerer if the target had taken {Element} DaSorcerer this combat before.
~Click on the Spell Icon to select the preferred Element!~

~Magic Arrows~.Effect:
Shoot 2 arcane arrows. Each does 1d4 Pulse DaSorcerer.
This turn, each arrow after the first into the same target deals only 1d2 instead.
~Magic Arrows~.Combo: 2 more arcane arrows shoot from the target into any targets within 5 meters of it. They ignore the same-target penalty.
~Magic Arrows~.Notes: When you cast this, decide the targets before rolling the dice. Roll the dice for each target at a time.

~Burning Breath~.Effect: All Units 3x3 meter area take 4 Fire DaSorcerer.
~Burning Breath~.Combo: If any affected Unit has a Combo, +50% total DaSorcerer (to all) and does not trigger the Cooldown.

~Volt Guard~.Effect:
Use when a Unit would take DaSorcerer (after roll). Negate 50% of the incoming DaSorcerer and return it back to the source as Shock DaSorcerer.
Apply a ~Combo~ to either of them.
~Volt Guard~.Upgrade: The returned DaSorcerer is a quick lightning that bends around obstacles, ignoring Cover or Line of Sight.

~Rime Shackles~.Effect:
Deal Cold DaSorcerer to a Unit equal to 1d12 + ^Its Dexterity^.
If it's Medium or smaller, Root it.
~Rime Shackles~.Combo: This either hits one more Unit within 2 meters of it, or also Single-Stuns the target.

~North Star~.Effect: You conjure a magical star that always shoots North and deals 5d10 Pulse DaSorcerer to the first Unit hit.
~North Star~.Combo: The star explodes, dealing 50% of the total DaSorcerer to all other Units within 2 meters of the hit target.
~North Star~.Notes:
You can only shoot the star towards North - without an angle.
Ask the DM which way North is (if your character knows that).

~Learn Scrolls~.Effect: If you have a Scroll that contains a Basic Ability (e.g. from Arcane, Nature, etc), you can destroy it to Know it permanently, without needing to learn it inbetween Adventures.
~Learn Scrolls~.Notes: You can not learn Class Abilities from Scrolls. Of course, you still need to spend Mana and respect the Cooldown of said Ability.

~Control Elements~.Notes:
{ElementNotes}
Apply common sense. The QM has the final word on whether something is possible.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 2x2x2 meter cube containing Fire.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Extinguish it
🔹 Lower or increase its intensity or light emission by 50%
🔹 Roughly alter its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: A Unit that touches the fire takes 2 DaSorcerer.

Variants.DoWhat:
Target a 1 meter cube containing {Element}.
Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Destroy it
🔹 Lower or increase its temperature down to near-freezing or near-boiling
🔹 Roughly its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: Water is Hard Terrain. A Unit that touches near-boiling or near-freezing water takes 2 DaSorcerer.

~Flash~.Effect: Instantly teleport up to 5 meters away, within line of sight.
~Flash~.Notes: You take with you all items carried. Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow.

~Magic Tricks~.Effect:
Choose one of these effects to cast:
{Diamond} Create harmless sensory effects, sparks or non-damaging heat or cold.
{Diamond} Channel to create simple, small, harmless illusions in your hand or within 3 meters.
{Diamond} Instantly clean or soil objects.
{Diamond} Control a quill with telekinesis to quickly write with it.

~Feather Fall~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units you choose will start falling gently, down to 3 meters per round.
Once the fall finishes, the spell effect ends.
~Feather Fall~.Notes:
Arcane Feathers can be bought in most towns.
For faster gameplay, you can spend 10 gold when casting the spell, and buy the feather later.

~Longblade~.Effect:
Magically extend the weapon of a willing ally you can see (or yourself) to up to 3 meters.
Its Attacks with that weapon can have up to 3 meters range.

<Guiled Casting>.Effect: When you roll 1 on the Unstable Spark die, after taking the DaSorcerer, you deal +1 DaSorcerer of a random DaSorcerer Type _permanently_ as long as you have this Talent.
<Guiled Casting>.Notes: 1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.

<Mild Casting>.Effect:
After you cast a Spell or one of its variants, you can't cast that spell or variant again this Combat.
Your base Unstable Spark also triggers on 9.

<Viled Casting>.Effect: All non-physical DaSorcerer you deal becomes Eldritch DaSorcerer. When you roll 5 on the Unstable Spark die, increase all Eldritch DaSorcerer you deal for the rest of the combat by 3. Then roll another Unstable Spark die.

<Sap>.Effect: A Unit must make a Presence Roll at least equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die or be Blinded, Silenced or Rooted (your choice).
<Sap>.Notes: What are you doing, just pick Wild Casting.

<Wild Casting>.Effect:
When you roll the Unstable Spark die, if you roll 2 or 3, roll 1d20. Freely cast that Spell from the table below, "randomly" by the QM.
If you rolled 2 on the Unstable Spark die, the effect is negative for your team. Otherwise, it's positive.
The lower Health you are, the more intense the effect (probably).
<Wild Casting>.Notes:
For example, if you roll 2 and the random Spell is Fire Enchantment, it will be cast on an enemy's weapon if possible (respecting the range). If not possible, then it will be cast on a random, non-Player Character's weapon. If not possible, then it will be cast on a Player Character's weapon. If nothing is possible, nothing happens.
If an effect can be cancelled or has ongoing effects, you have control of them as if you yourself had cast the Spell.

SpellTable.Name: 1. Fake Sound
SpellTable.Effect: A sound is magically created at a point (it can Silence some Units).

SpellTable.Name: 2. Quicksand
SpellTable.Effect: An 3x3 to 9x9 area becomes Hard Terrain.

SpellTable.Name: 3. Conjure Steed
SpellTable.Effect: A random animal is conjured as a mount for 1 to 5 Units.

SpellTable.Name: 4. Force Wall
SpellTable.Effect: A thin 2x2 to 6x6 transparent wall is created.

SpellTable.Name: 5. Obstable Break
SpellTable.Effect: One or more obstacles or traps are destroyed.

SpellTable.Name: 6. Strange Wave
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are Healed or DaSorcererd for 1d4.

SpellTable.Name: 7. Teleportation
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are teleported 1 to 10 meters.

SpellTable.Name: 8. Fog
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 fog cloud is created.

SpellTable.Name: 9. Enchanted Weapons
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units have their weapons enchanted (+2 DaSorcerer, any element)

SpellTable.Name: 10. Invisibility
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units become invisible for 1 to 99 Turns.

SpellTable.Name: 11. FULMINATION
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 explosion happens, dealing 2d6 to 6d6 DaSorcerer of any element.

SpellTable.Name: 12. Fling
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 objects or items are flung around. If any hits a Unit, deals 1d6 DaSorcerer.

SpellTable.Name: 13. Thunder Clap
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 to 6 meters of you take 1d6 to 3d6 DaSorcerer (any type).

SpellTable.Name: 14. Wilder Casting
SpellTable.Effect: Roll 2 more times on this table.

SpellTable.Name: 15. Reverse Gravity
SpellTable.Effect: The gravity in a 3x3x3 to 9x9x9 area is reversed.

SpellTable.Name: 16. Banish
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units are banished to another plane for 1 Turn. When they come back, they immediately take 1 Turn.

SpellTable.Name: 17. Unknowable Health
SpellTable.Effect: A Unit is healed for 5 to 55 Health.

SpellTable.Name: 18. Lightning Strikes Again
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units get any Crowd Control.

SpellTable.Name: 19. Nervous System Jolt
SpellTable.Effect: One Unit permanently gains +1 in a Stat, or +1 to +3 Max Health, Regen or Mana.

SpellTable.Name: 20. Resurrection
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 dead or Fallen Units come back to life (without Exhaustion) with 1 to full Health.

<Arcano Mantissa>.Effect: When you roll 4 on the Unstable Spark die, gain 0.5 Max Health and 0.25 Max Mana.
<Arcano Mantissa>.Notes: Mana and Health can't be expended or DaSorcererd in fractions, but if you manage to get this 2 times, you essentially get +1 Health permanently (or 1 Mana permanently if you trigger this 4 times).

<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Effect:
Your Unstable Spark die becomes 1d12 instead of 1d10, and triggers on 11 and 12 instead of 10.
Your d12 dice become d14's, 1d14's become d16's, etc, when they have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die tier.
<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Notes: I don't know. You're a Sorcerer, figure it out.

<Second Try>.Effect: Use after you roll an Unstable Spark die. You may cancel the roll. Then roll 2 more.

<Star Burst>.Effect:
Declare up to 4 different targets you can see.
Assign a different number from #1 to #4 to each.
Roll a number of d4's equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die. Each d4 rolled deals that much Pulse DaSorcerer to the target with that number.
Each rolled 1 deals 1 DaSorcerer to target number #1, each rolled 2 deals 2 DaSorcerer to target number #2, and so on.
<Star Burst>.Notes:
E.g. if you put #2 on a goblin, and you roll three 2's on the d4's, then that goblin takes 6 Pulse DaSorcerer.
You should probably assign the higher number to the target you want to do most DaSorcerer to.
You can declare fewer targets, but then the missing number will deal DaSorcerer to no target.
Cover is applied normally.

~Reverse Gravity~.Effect:
Declare an area with a diameter in meters (in all directions) equal to your Level.
The gravity becomes reversed in that area and all Units instantly fall upwards. Units can make a Dexterity Check to grab onto an object to not be lifted.
Units suffer fall DaSorcerer if they fall onto a ceiling.
When the effect ends, all Units fall at half velocity (and take half of the fall DaSorcerer). The same happens to a Unit if it exits the area.
Lasts for up to 1 minute. You can cancel this effect at will.
~Reverse Gravity~.Notes: Fall DaSorcerer is 1d6 for every 2 meters fallen (e.g. 1d6 for 2 and 3 meters, 2d6 for 4 and 5 meters, etc).

~Hearth Recall~.Effect:
You can spend 10 minutes in a place to Bind to it.
When you use this Ability, channel for 10 minutes to teleport up to 1d6 Allies (and yourself) within 10 meters of you to the bound place.
You can only have 1 bound place at a time.
~Hearth Recall~.EffectRed: You can teleport more Allies than the rolled die, but the teleportation will have strange side effects or consequences.
~Hearth Recall~.Notes: You can remove the binding of a place at will, from any distance.

<Great Sorcery>.Effect: When you roll 8 or 9 on the Unstable Spark die, gain 1 Mana.

<Accidental Zap>.Effect: When you roll 6, 7 or 8 on the Unstable Spark die, immediately Zap the closest Unit to you for ^your Intelligence^ Shock DaSorcerer.

<Chronomancy>.Effect:
Instantly return to how and where you were at the start of your turn (or your previous turn if it's not currently your turn), with that same Movement, Actions, Health, Shielding, Buffs and Cooldowns (not Mana, though).
Alternatively, if you're out of combat, you can turn back time for all the world up to 10 minutes, exactly how it was, but retaining all your information from the future. Allies don't retain the information.

<Double Spark Triple Quark>.Effect: Whenever you would roll an Unstable Spark die, roll 2 instead of one. Apply effects for both.

<Grand Sorcery>.Effect:
Arcane power flows potently through your veins! Whenever you would roll one or more Unstable Spark dice, roll 3 more.
Whenever you would roll dice for a Spell, all the dice are a baseline d10, no matter what die type it is (can still have ^Dice Upgraded^).
<Grand Sorcery>.Upgrade: Your appearance changes to reflect your sorcerer powers, resulting in glowing eyes, or your hair resembling a particular element, like fire or electricity.

<Locus of Control>.Effect:
You gain control over your own magic, and, whenever you would roll an Unstable Spark die, you can instead choose the number. In fact, whenever you roll one or more dice for a Spell, instead of rolling half of them, you can even choose the numbers.
Screw it, once per Round, when someone else would roll a die, just name what number you want and it happens!
<Locus of Control>.Upgrade: The control over magic reflects in your physical appearance, resulting in effects such as contracted pupils, uncannily smooth body and hair, or an uncoventionally toned voice.

<Draconianism>.Effect:
Your natural form changes to that of a large, winged dragon. Your base Maximum Mana increases by 10 and your base Max Health by 50%. You can fly at your normal Speed.
You must choose what color you are as a dragon. As your breath attack, you can cast any Basic Ability that deals DaSorcerer and doesn't cost Mana, and it also hits all Units within 2 meters of the main target. You also take -50% DaSorcerer from the DaSorcerer Type of your chosen Ability.
<Draconianism>.Upgrade: You can transform into your person-self at will, but, to you, your dragon form is more comfortable.
